description: Return provider-computed keyword registration statistics. hot and emerging cover rolling keyword cohorts; prefix returns prefix activity buckets. scope=all represents the provider's filtered all-gTLD sample, while scope=com represents its pure-letter .com subset and is not available for prefix. Results are representative samples, not a complete registry feed, demand measurement, valuation, or investment recommendation.

scope.description: all = filtered all-gTLD sample; com = pure-letter .com subset. prefix supports all only.

name: keywords_trends

coverage.description: Provider coverage identifier, such as all_gTLDs or com_letters_only.

com_count.description: Absolute .com count when supplied directly by the provider.

com_ratio.description: Share of registrations in the provider sample that are .com.

count_28d.description: Provider sample count over 28 days for hot and emerging rows.

digit_ratio.description: Share of sampled labels containing digits when supplied.

forsale_pct.description: Percentage of the sample whose nameservers match the provider's configured sale-platform set.

might_use_count.description: Provider-supplied usage-status count under its own classification.

most_tld.description: Most frequent TLD in the provider sample.

most_tld_ratio.description: Share of the most frequent TLD in the provider sample.

pos_end_ratio.description: Share of sampled labels with the keyword at the end.

pos_start_ratio.description: Share of sampled labels with the keyword at the start.

top_ns.description: Most frequent nameserver in the provider sample.

top_ns_ratio.description: Share of the most frequent nameserver in the provider sample.

top_registrar.description: Deprecated: the first entry of top_registrars, kept for compatibility.

top_registrars.description: Registrar ranking computed by the data source; not derived from nrds.

word.description: Keyword for hot and emerging rows.

data_date.description: Provider data date when supplied; never synthesized from request time.

error.description: Error message when success is false.

sample_type.description: Provider sampling description, such as filtered_representative_sample.

updated_at.description: Provider update timestamp when supplied; never synthesized from request time.

window_days.description: Provider-defined rolling observation window when supplied.

title: Keyword Registration Trends
